label: PAX5::ETV6

sections.text: PAX5 encodes a paired-box transcription factor required for B-cell identity.
ETV6 encodes an ETS-family transcriptional repressor with an amino-terminal oligomerization domain.
The fusion joins PAX5 DNA-binding sequences to ETV6 regulatory regions, impairing normal PAX5-dependent B-cell differentiation. It is a recurrent lesion within PAX5-altered B-ALL.
